Verses.26: While they were eating, Jesus took some bread. After blessing it, He broke it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, "Take, eat. This is My body."
Verses.27: Then He took a cup, and when He had given thanks, He gave it to them, saying, "Drink from it, all of you.
Verses.28: Drink, for this is My blood of the covenant, which is being poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
Verses.29: I tell you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine again, until that day when I drink it with you, afresh, in My Father's kingdom."
